normalized.title: Regional Resource On-boarding to the Network of Resources
normalized.description:
The scope of this procurement shall support integration of regional resources (inter alia data, algorithms, models) into the Network of Resources (NoR) portfolio and manage the interaction with the regional community. As fragmentation is a major obstacle to efficiently use the “bring the user to the data” approach, regional resources shall be integrated in a partnership approach as much as possible into existing NoR Exploitation Platforms. 

Exploitation Platforms are a central element of ESA's Earth Observation (EO) Innovation Europe concept, which aims at the integration of EO data and information for a much broader use, for scientific, social and economic purposes, as well as for the generation of new commercial applications and services. 

The EO NoR initiative promotes the use of European resource and platform services to facilitate a simplified and efficient exploitation of EO data in cloud environments. The initiative incentivizes providers to contribute to a common framework harmonising the access to their services and helping the user to work with the data. ESA conducted an ITT (AO/1-9217/18/I-LG-Procurement of Earth Observation Exploitation Platform Network Resource Services) in 2018. The tender awarded a contract in December 2018 to Cloudeo AG as prime to select under the supervision of ESA, and via ESA’s Best Practices Processes, the services of eligible Resource and Platform Tier Providers. A NoR portal (https://nor-discover.cloudeo.group) lists in an online directory all the onboarded providers together with their NoR service portfolio. 

ESA can sponsor or co-fund scientists and value adding users for eligible research, development and pre-commercial projects. The portal also provides users with links to each providers helpdesk and website.
